name: AECi — Data quality check found ERROR-severity issues (by check)
message:
A §23.1 data-quality check found one or more **error-severity** issues in the daily run (AECI-241 / Phase 7.6; scoped to `severity:error` by AECI-279 / Phase 8.1). The two error-severity checks are `broken_integration_refs` (an integration referencing a pulled product) and `reviews_missing_anonymized_at` — both are data-integrity faults worth paging on. The alert is split `by {check}`, so the offending check is named in the alert tags; the gauge value is the issue count for that check (the per-check gauge is emitted every run, 0 when clean — so this only fires on a real finding). **Warn-severity** checks (`products_without_vendor`, `duplicate_products`, `logo_404`, `algolia_index_drift`, …) no longer fire this monitor — they are carried by the companion 'AECi — Data quality check found WARN-severity issues' monitor (informational, non-paging) and the daily email digest. A separate failed/crash monitor watches the sentinel -1 (a check that threw). This is **report-only** — the digest to Chris + Bill carries the offending rows; triage and fix manually, and the next daily run re-checks.

Note: notify_no_data is OFF here — liveness is the companion 'AECi — Data quality job not running' monitor. The > 0 threshold is intentionally sensitive; per-check thresholds (e.g. tolerate N known duplicate candidates) are launch-tunable.

Runbook: https://github.com/the-wbs-project/aec-integrations/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOKS.md#data-quality-job-failed-or-not-running
